shard.almanac.flavor: A record of every season it has outlived, bound into something that no longer decays.
shard.almanac.name: Almanac Shard

shard.chaff.flavor: A husk shed before the seed even noticed it was growing. Barely worth the pocket it rides in.
shard.chaff.name: Chaff Shard

shard.chimeric.flavor: Its grain runs in more than one direction, as though it could not decide what it was becoming.
shard.chimeric.name: Chimeric Shard

shard.cultivated.flavor: Tended rather than found, its edges shaped by patient, deliberate hands.
shard.cultivated.name: Cultivated Shard

shard.firstseed.flavor: The kind every later growth is measured against, and rarely matches.
shard.firstseed.name: Firstseed Shard

shard.fused.flavor: What used to be several pieces, now closed into one that no longer shows the seams.
shard.fused.name: Fused Shard

shard.grafted.flavor: Two growths bound at the seam until neither remembers which one it started as.
shard.grafted.name: Grafted Shard

shard.heirloom.flavor: Carried longer than anyone alive can say, and asked after by name.
shard.heirloom.name: Heirloom Shard

shard.sprout.flavor: Still soft at the edges, but it has decided to keep growing. A first real step past the husk.
shard.sprout.name: Sprout Shard

shard.sunwoven.flavor: Warmth is caught in it rather than reflected, as if the light never quite left.
shard.sunwoven.name: Sunwoven Shard
